summary.text: One of the forty-four suitors from Zacynthus in Apollodorus' island catalogue — wholly distinct from Polydorus son of Cadmus and Harmonia, king in the Theban succession.

story.text: Apollodorus names Polydorus among the wooers who came from Zacynthus, listed after Polybus and before Thadytius in Epitome 7.29.
